name: smwpatches-nsmb-styled-carry-system
title: NSMB Styled Carry System
description:
Make the carrying system NSMB-like.
You will no longer be able to put your shell in place or throw sprites upward.
Also, you will not be able to crouch, look up, or enter a dirt pipe or door when you are holding an sprites.

The shell will not be able to be taken out of Yoshi's mouth and put in its place. (The same goes for Buzzy Beetle.)
